_comment: Config for professor_extract_runner.py. Input rows now carry a list of grounding chunks (URLs Google Search returned for the uni+dept), NOT a single faculty_directory_url. Claude picks the best URL itself; if nothing usable, the pair is logged as skipped.
_input_jsonl_note: One JSON object per line. Required fields: university, department, grounding_chunks. grounding_chunks is a list of either (a) plain URL strings or (b) {"url": "...", "title": "..."} objects. Optional: pair_id, country, tier, source. Built by consolidate_faculty_urls.py (Phase 1, not in this batch).
_id_field_note: If pair_id is missing, the runner derives <uni_slug>__<dept_slug>.
_output_layout: Per-(uni, dept) JSON written to output_professors/universities/<uni_slug>/<dept_slug>.json. State log at output_professors/state.jsonl. A flat skipped index at output_professors/skipped.jsonl.
_max_professors_note: Cap to keep cost/time bounded. Most departments have 20-50 profs. Med schools and giant CS depts may exceed this — overflow is acknowledged in extraction_notes.
_fetch_personal_websites_note: If true, the runner asks Claude to web_fetch each professor's personal_website_url. The runner stores the cleaned page text to a sibling .md file (NOT inline in the per-pair JSON, which keeps the JSON small). Set false to skip the personal-site fetch entirely.
_max_personal_site_chars_note: Hard cap on the per-prof .md file size. AgentCore Browser already truncates web_fetch output to ~15KB cleaned, so this is a safety net for unusually large pages. Set to 0 for no runner-side cap (still bounded by AgentCore).
